description: Account list, perhaps communal based on the number of orphans and widows mentioned (entries starting with the abbreviations יתו and אל). Dating: the paleography supports an estimate of 18th- or 19th-centuryת as does the qurush currency symbol at the top of the left monetary column (this coinage began to circulate in this timespan). Many names are mentioned that could likely help narrow the date range with further research, such as: or[phan] of David Naʿīm, Ḥayyīm Shtawī, Saʿd Munīr, Mūsa Ḥanan, Rafaʾel Moṣeri (Mosseri), Esther Ḥanīna, or[phan] of Salmūn Ḥanīn, among others. MCD.
